summary.text:
Kimi needs to write CODESYS ST FB_Task with interface and behavior. Should compile via tool max3. I'll respond concise after success. Should reason carefully scan semantics edges, mode change, estop edge history. Should have implementation robust.

Declaration FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_Task VAR_INPUT all exact types, VAR_OUTPUT all, VAR internal prev buttons, prevOpeMode, initialized? phase INT, latchedProcessMode BOOL perhaps manual latches outputs themselves. Should handle initial conditions and mode changes. Each test resets instance; first invocation prevOpeMode default FALSE could cause mode change if initial auto true, clearing (fine), but edge prev autoStart false. Should avoid treating first auto mode as problematic: clear then still process autoStart same scan? Requirements tests T2 first auto opeMode true no autoStart expected off, second autoStart true expected A. If mode change first scan clear and return? Could still no outputs; okay. T1 first manual false no change. Better initialization tracking to prevent artificial mode change? Not necessary but implement first scan initialization with prevOpeMode := opeMode and no reset perhaps outputs defaults. Simpler detect mode change every scan if opeMode <> prevOpeMode. On first auto true, resets phase, latches, then can process auto logic in same scan. Fine.

Emergency: edge history updates during estop so held buttons cannot restart on recovery. At each invocation compute rising edges based on previous samples then update prev at end or beginning. During emergency reset all, phase IDLE, update all prev including autoStart. On recovery with held autoStart no edge. Mode change also reset and edge histories update. Fresh autoStart edge required to restart after estop/mode reset. If mode change with autoStart rising same scan, should it start? Ambiguous. Could clear and then process using computed edge, likely okay but "fresh autoStart edge required" rising current qualifies. I can structure.

Automatic sequence: phase 0 IDLE,1 FILL_A,2 FILL_B,3 FILL_C,4 MIX,5 DRAIN. Latched process mode at start to keep fixed. Outputs default false each scan then set according to new phase after transition. One transition per invocation using CASE pre-phase and IF. On autoStart rising accepted in IDLE -> phase FILL_A and latch processMode. Output A same scan. In FILL_A if level>=50 -> B. FILL_B if level>=80 then if latched process mode C else MIX. FILL_C >=100 -> MIX. MIX if mixMotorComplete -> DRAIN. DRAIN hold D. Automatic phases one actuator. In IDLE none. autoStart ignored outside IDLE. In auto mode manual ignored.

Manual toggles independent rising edges. Outputs as latches. Could simply toggle output vars after setting? Should default handling. Structure:
- compute edge bools from current and prev.
- update prev at end? Many returns complicate. No early returns, use IF.
- detect mode change. At beginning:
rA := valveAStart AND NOT prevValveAStart etc.
prev... := current at end. prevOpeMode update end.
IF NOT estop THEN reset all phase, latched false
ELSIF opeMode <> prevOpeMode THEN reset all phase; perhaps then process current mode in same scan? Should not separate ELSIF preventing normal operation if mode changed. Assumption changing mode clears old latches and sequence. Could reset then continue, enabling new inputs same scan. Better:
IF NOT estop ...
ELSE
  IF opeMode <> prevOpeMode THEN clear... END_IF;
  IF opeMode THEN auto... ELSE manual... END_IF;
END_IF;
update histories.
First auto initial prev false -> clear then auto works. First manual no clear but defaults.

Manual outputs can be toggled directly; no default zero each scan except auto. For auto, set all outputs false before case and set based on resulting phase. Mode change to auto clears manual. Mode change to manual clears sequence and outputs, then manual edges can toggle. Emergency resets all.

Potential issue initial auto mode first scan triggers mode reset and phase IDLE; okay. Initial outputs default false. Prev process etc.

No need R_TRIG instances; bool edge simpler. CODESYS variable names not reserved. Declaration internal VAR : rA etc BOOL; phase INT; autoProcessMode BOOL; prevOpeMode BOOL. Could omit initialized. Exact interface.

Should compile. Use JSON string. Ensure no END_FUNCTION_BLOCK declaration. Implementation ST body alone. supporting_objects [].

I'll call compile.
